fields.Name: Daily Tasks Triage
fields.Description: Weekday morning triage covering overdue, due-today, blocked, newly assigned, and waiting-on-others tasks, plus scheduling pre-meeting prep and post-meeting transcript wakes.
fields.WakeReason: Run weekday morning tasks triage via Assemble My Briefing: surface overdue, due today, blocked, newly assigned, and waiting-on-others items, and schedule meeting prep/transcript wakes for qualifying meetings.

fields.Name: Weekly Tasks Review
fields.Description: Friday afternoon review summarizing completed vs. slipped tasks, open loops waiting on others, stalled blockers, and team work pulse signals.
fields.WakeReason: Run Friday weekly review via Assemble My Briefing and Find Tasks: summarize completed vs. slipped items, open waiting-on-others loops, and recommended cleanup for next week.

fields.Name: Daily Work Report
fields.Description: End-of-day work report draft synthesized from your task completions, check-ins, and updates (skips quietly on NO_ACTIVITY) and presented for author approval before submitting to your supervisor.
fields.WakeReason: Call Draft Work Report for today; stop silently on NO_ACTIVITY, otherwise present the concise draft for author approval before submission.
